subject.title: fix(sessions): bound AGENTS.md and prompt-input file reads with size cap

question: Should OpenClaw reject existing AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files above a fixed 1 MiB limit on upgrade, or should the bounded-read behavior preserve a documented compatibility path for those existing instruction files?
rationale: The hard cap is a new user-visible policy: current main loads these files without that size restriction, while partial loading could itself alter instruction semantics.

options.title: Adopt a documented fixed cap
options.body: Keep a fixed project-context limit, document the upgrade behavior, and ensure the implementation enforces it on the opened file descriptor.

options.title: Preserve compatibility with a bounded design
options.body: Choose a bounded, documented handling path that does not abruptly discard existing oversized project instructions, while still preventing unbounded allocation.

options.title: Pause the context-file portion
options.body: Land only the separately bounded prompt-input path and defer AGENTS.md policy until maintainers set the intended compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve compatibility with a bounded design
recommendation.body: Choose a bounded, documented handling path that does not abruptly discard existing oversized project instructions, while still preventing unbounded allocation.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected behavior follows the Pi-derived resource-loader contract, so this is the strongest available design-routing signal.
